proposals.limiting_assay: sulfonylurea/meglitinide screen (LC-MS/MS send-out); main assay insulin/C-peptide immunoassay [3]
proposals.reason: Clar. 25: score the limiting assay. The drug screen is a specialised send-out and can miss newer agents (V3 own reading: 1). Insulin and C-peptide immunoassays are standard US laboratory tests [3 on availability; method differences in insulin, inter-lab CV 22.2% per PMID 38549041, argue for 2-3]. The critical-sample timing that V3 used to reach 2 is D5. Older-generation assay data are part of the sources; confidence capped at medium (clar. 20).

proposals.limiting_assay: anti-insulin-receptor antibody (research bridge assay, NIH 2023, PMID 36869714); genetic testing is a clinical send-out (1); main assay fasting insulin [2]
proposals.reason: Clar. 25: the antibody has no clinical assay, so research only (0). If the use case is read as needing only fasting insulin plus genetics, the limiting assay is the genetic send-out and 1 stands. Fasting insulin is routine but unstandardised, JDS >30 uU/mL has no assay named [2]. Resolves the measure-type mismatch V19 flagged (D4 vs D1/D2/D8). Low confidence because the proposed score depends on which part of the bundle the row is read to require.

proposals.limiting_assay: PEG precipitation (lab-developed, no standard protocol) with insulin autoantibody testing (often send-out); main assay insulin plus C-peptide immunoassay [2]
proposals.reason: Clar. 25: V22 listed these steps as lab-developed/send-out in its own reason, which is anchor 1 wording. Main assay [2]: widely available, among-assay CV 12-66% (median 24%) on 2007-era platforms (PMID 17272483), older-generation data, confidence capped at medium (clar. 20). Use the same value as row 25 for the shared PEG step (V25 flag).

proposals.limiting_assay: IGF-II / big IGF-II (send-out, research-type methods, PMID 39689018); main assay insulin and C-peptide, suppression read at the low end [2]
proposals.reason: Clar. 25: confirmatory IGF-II is a send-out, limiting assay 1. Main insulin/C-peptide assay [2]: widely available (3 on availability) but cutoffs are assay-dependent (36 pmol/L did not transfer to a specific ELISA, older-generation data, PMID 15026285). The need for a critical sample at documented low glucose is D5, not counted. If the use case is read as the insulin/C-peptide step only, 2 stands.

proposals.limiting_assay: PEG precipitation (lab-developed) with antibody testing (often send-out); main assay insulin and C-peptide [2]
proposals.reason: Clar. 25: unchanged. Limiting assay is the same PEG/antibody step as row 20, so rows 20 and 25 now carry one value (V25 flag). The infant critical sample and paired maternal draw that V22 cited as extra penalty are D5. No validated recovery cutoff found, older-generation and case-report data, confidence low.

proposals.limiting_assay: none in the scored part: fasting-based first-trimester HOMA-IR (part b); GCK genetic test (part a) is not an insulin measure and is not scored (clar. 27); main assay fasting insulin [2]
proposals.reason: Clar. 25 changes nothing: one assay, widely available, unstandardised (PMID 17272483), no pregnancy-specific interval found. Not bundled once clar. 27 is applied, so the GCK send-out is not the limiting assay.
